title: Shabbir sada dete
body:
hal min nasirin yan suruna
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kis haal may shabbir sada dete hai
ran may soye huwe laashe bhi utha dete hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hausle se wo har ek laash uthaate hi rahe
jaane akbar pe kyun wo khud ko gira dete hai
jaane kis haal may...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi naiza koi talwaar koi teeron se
is tarha ajre risaalat ka sila dete hai
jaane kis haal may...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha farwa ne kahan hai mera qasim maula
khol ke maula usay ghatri dikha dete hai
jaane kis haal may...
<<DIVIDER>>
kahin pamaal na hojaye asghar e masoom
tapti reti pe wo moti ko chupa dete hai
jaane kis haal may...
<<DIVIDER>>
de ke sadqa ali akbar ka hussain ibne ali
dard saare salamat ko rika dete hai
jaane kis haal may...
